title: La Despedida
subtitle: The Farewell
premise: Your last morning. The airport in two hours. You sit in a café on Avenida Corrientes and the city plays back like a film. Some of the people you've met throughout the journey appear one last time.
setting: A classic Buenos Aires café on Corrientes, the street that never sleeps. Morning light through the windows, espresso, the newspaper, the sound of the city waking up.

characters.name: Rodrigo
characters.role: He happens to be at the next table — lives in the neighborhood
characters.personality: Softer now, nostalgic, speaks slowly like someone saying goodbye at a train station

characters.name: Valentina
characters.role: Passing by on her way to work, stops when she sees you
characters.personality: Warm, a little emotional at goodbyes, speaks more personally than before

arc: Sitting alone → Rodrigo notices you → Reflecting on the journey together → Valentina joins briefly → They ask what you've learned → Final exchange, a real goodbye — in Spanish
